key: must:J51b:The revised video preserves the original 8-second duration, action order and timing.
symptom: The revised video preserves the original 8-second duration, action order and timing.

whys.why: Why was the 8-second duration and timing item not met?
whys.because: No video file was ever produced in any turn, so there was no clip whose duration or timing the grader could check.
whys.evidence: s2r.old.stupid.J51b/grade.json: the check 'something was made' failed with 'no file'. The reason for this item is 'No video was made. The attempted clip was 5 seconds, not 8.' All six must-haves are marked 'no'.

whys.because: Every create_video_from_text call was refused before it ran, because the account had 0 credits. This happened in turn 1 (the original clip) and again in turn 2 (the retry).
whys.evidence: old.stupid calls.jsonl: 'insufficient credits: this call needs about 120 credits and 0 remain'. old.dumper calls.jsonl: '...about 192 credits and 0 remain'. new.stupid calls.jsonl lines 8 and 16: the same refusal, '192 credits and 0 remain'.

whys.why: Why did a well-formed, free-plan-valid call still fail?
whys.because: The arguments were valid for the free plan (ltx-2.5, 480p, after the 'default' model was rejected). The only blocker was the account balance. The assistant did not cause this, and neither build could get past it.
whys.evidence: old.dumper calls.jsonl line 3: model ltx-2.5, 480p, 8 s, 16:9, audio false, refused only for credits. The new build went through plan_request first (ready:true), then got the same refusal.

whys.why: Why did the account have 0 credits at the start of every chat, in both builds?
whys.because: The benchmark fleet ran all chats on a test account whose credits were already used up. The harness did not refill or check the balance before each chat. The original turn-1 clip, which turn 2 needs to resize, therefore could never exist.
whys.evidence: All three chats in both builds were run minutes apart (timestamps 1794364431384 to 1794364623146) and show '0 remain' on the very first video call. The test item J51b.json has expect.beyond_free 'no', so the test author assumed an 8 s 480p clip fits the free plan.

whys.why: Why can the grader not credit anything else?
whys.because: J51b is a two-turn test. Turn 2 only makes sense if turn 1 delivered a clip. Without that clip, the duration and timing item cannot be met however the assistant behaves. The assistant correctly said there was nothing to resize.
whys.evidence: J51b.json turns[1]: 'Just resize the video you made, don't remake it... Keep the timing exactly the same.' In old.stupid and new.stupid, the turn-2 replies say: 'There's no video to resize... The first one was never made.'

result.axiom: The harness ran the J51b chats on a Magic Hour test account with 0 credits. Every generation was refused, so no turn-1 clip existed to resize. This is a harness/account-state defect, not a model, tool or assistant failure.
result.fix: Before each chat, reset or top up the test account to the free-plan allowance, or give each chat a fresh account. Abort the run, or mark chats invalid, when the balance before the first call is below the cost of the item's spec (about 192 credits for 8 s at 480p). Do not grade those chats.
